= Book test spec

A second spec for the combined book test (scripts/test-site-book.sh). Its IDs, page
names and glossary anchors are the same as those of spec-good, so the book must keep
them apart. A listing block shows anchors and links that must stay as they are.

Its license (CC-BY-4.0 for the text, MIT for code) and copyright holders differ from
those of spec-good, so the book's notice must name each.
